author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam Savage visits Smithsonian's @airandspace for a first look at an extraordinary new addition to the collection: the Pathfinder for the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST)! Space history curator Samantha Thompson walks Adam through this full-scale engineering model, which was essential to proving out the telescope's multi-stage origami unfolding, extreme temperature tolerances, and precision optics before the real JWST launched a million miles into deep space. Adam inspects the massive backplane structure, the secondary mirror assembly, and two real beryllium hexagonal mirrors — one uncoated and one coated in microscopically thin gold — to explore the engineering marvels that paved the way for one of humanity's greatest engineering achievements!

National Air and Space Museum: https://airandspace.si.edu/
Visit the National Air and Space Museum's Udvar Hazy Center: https://www.si.edu/museums/air-and-space-museum-udvar-hazy-center
